stories.title: Leading the Way
stories.detail: Daniel Pocius on 16 pts - a lead the Storm would kill for this year

stories.title: Welcome to WWCC
stories.detail: Good to see you, Anthony Guthrie - a warm WWCC welcome from all of us. Have a cracking round.

stories.title: Big-Dog Territory
stories.detail: 3-pointers on 2 of the par 5s - bombing them and cashing in

stories.title: Building Something
stories.detail: 3 twos on holes 14, 15 & 16 - the round is taking shape

stories.title: The Null Hypothesis
stories.detail: 6 twos on holes 10-15 - the scorecard is a flatline

stories.title: The Golf Tax Strikes Again
stories.detail: 3-pointer to 1-pointer on holes 13 & 14 - the course always takes its cut

stories.title: Brief Interruption
stories.detail: Back-to-back wipes on holes 15 & 16 - we'll pretend this didn't happen

stories.title: The Golf Tax
stories.detail: One good hole then one bad on holes 10 & 11 - the course charges a fee for everything
